name: Mailchimp Newsletter Signup Form
description: Let visitors can easily join your Mailchimp email marketing list.

2.label: This form template uses the Mailchimp addon.
2.description: With the Mailchimp addon, you can connect WPForms to your Mailchimp account to automatically add subscribers to your mailing lists when they fill out your form. Before you publish this form, go to the Marketing tab to the left and: [] Install and activate the Mailchimp addon. [] Connect your Mailchimp account to WPForms using your Mailchimp API key. [] Choose your Mailchimp account, audience, and the action you wish to perform. [] Map your form's fields to your Mailchimp account. If you're new to this addon, see our Mailchimp addon documentation for full details. For more help, contact our support team.
2.expanded-description:
In addition to adding new subscribers to your lists, the Mailchimp addon enables your users to unsubscribe or delete their information from your account, providing a seamless, user-friendly experience.

You can also segment your subscribers by adding users to different lists in your Mailchimp account. 

You'll be able to add Mailchimp tags and notes to your subscribers as well, providing helpful data about your users right in your email marketing account.

Last but not least, if you have custom fields set up in Mailchimp for unique subscriber information, you can map them to fields in your form to automatically collect that data.
